invariants: At least one OWNER ACTIVE per tenant while tenant status <> CLOSED
OWNER cannot self-demote if last OWNER
OWNER cannot self-revoke if last OWNER
role change requires ADMIN+ in same tenant
no self-elevation: caller's target role <= caller's own role
SUSPENDED user cannot perform any tenant-scoped operation
REVOKED is terminal; reactivation requires new membership row

role_definitions.OWNER: Full control; billing; tenant lifecycle; sole role able to promote other OWNER
role_definitions.ADMIN: Manages memberships (except OWNER), settings, all data
role_definitions.MANAGER: Business operations across all domains; no user administration
role_definitions.OPERATOR: Day-to-day CRUD on operational data (sales, purchases, receivables)

support_access_rule: Platform operator (HUMAN-SO-01) MUST NOT be in tenant_memberships by default. Any exceptional access requires justified, time-limited, audited grant.
legacy_compat: user_roles table retained read-only during Expand; new authorization sourced exclusively from tenant_memberships once flag MULTITENANT_RLS_ENABLED is on per-tenant.
